{"initial_observation":{"company":"CLOSE_fin_01","message":"The ledger is accessed through the supplied SQL tools."},"max_actions":10,"task":"Company CLOSE_fin_01 keeps a single heterogeneous ledger table. Every record type is stored in ledger, so SQL self-joins and CTEs can be used. Close the payable ledger as it was known at recorded_at <= 2026-10-24T12:00:00, for business_date <= 2026-10-23. All timestamps are UTC ISO text. Start by excluding rows with future business dates and rows recorded late, then keep only the highest revision for each (kind,event_key). If that latest row has status void, the key is removed entirely; never fall back to an older row. Invoice rows use event_key as the invoice ID; payment, credit and hold rows use invoice_id to point to their parent invoice. Keep the active invoices for vendor BLUE with due_date <= 2026-10-30. Payments and credits reduce the gross amount_minor, in the invoice currency. Active holds reduce the remaining amount; holds with status release or void do not. Clamp as follows: remaining=max(0,gross-sum(payments)-sum(credits)), then unheld=max(0,remaining-sum(active holds)). For each invoice, pick the active terms row that has the same terms_code and the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date (applying the same revision and as-of filtering). The discounted amount is unheld * (10000-discount_bps)/10000 only when 2026-10-23 <= discount_until; otherwise it is unheld. Next, pick the active FX row for that invoice's currency with the greatest business_date <= the invoice business_date. Convert to USD cents using fx_num/fx_den. Round only this final per-invoice amount to the nearest cent, rounding exact halves up. Sum the rounded per-invoice USD cents. Invoices in USD also have FX rows. Do not net invoices together before rounding. Submit only the integer number of USD cents.","task_id":"fin-01","tools":[{"description":"Get a list of available table names for a company.","name":"get_descriptions","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Get table metadata: description, columns, types, unique values.","name":"get_table_info","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Execute a SQL query on a table. Select * not allowed.

Filters are required: WHERE, HAVING, IN, NOT IN, EXISTS, NOT EXISTS,
ANY, SOME, ALL, LIKE, NOT LIKE, BETWEEN, NOT BETWEEN, IS NULL,
IS NOT NULL, CASE, FILTER.","name":"sql_query","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"company_name":{"description":"The name of the company","type":"string"},"query":{"description":"SQL query to execute (must include filters)","type":"string"},"table_name":{"description":"The name of the table","type":"string"}},"required":["company_name","table_name","query"],"type":"object"}},{"description":"Submit a final answer for the question.","name":"submit_answer","parameters":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"answer":{"description":"The final answer to submit","type":"string"}},"required":["answer"],"type":"object"}}]}

{"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_01","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,recorded_at,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND recorded_at <= '2026-10-24T12:00:00'), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void') SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM active WHERE kind IN ('invoice','payment','credit','hold','terms','fx') ORDER BY kind,event_key"} }

item.text: {"tool":"sql_query","arguments":{"company_name":"CLOSE_fin_01","table_name":"ledger","query":"WITH ranked AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,revision,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind,event_key ORDER BY revision DESC) AS rn FROM ledger WHERE business_date <= '2026-10-23' AND recorded_at <= '2026-10-24T12:00:00'), active AS (SELECT kind,event_key,invoice_id,vendor,business_date,status,amount_minor,currency,due_date,discount_until,terms_code,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 AND status <> 'void'), balances AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.business_date,i.currency,i.discount_until,i.terms_code,i.amount_minor-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM active p WHERE p.kind IN ('payment','credit') AND p.status='active' AND p.invoice_id=i.event_key AND p.currency=i.currency),0) AS balance,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(h.amount_minor) FROM active h WHERE h.kind='hold' AND h.status='active' AND h.invoice_id=i.event_key AND h.currency=i.currency),0) AS held FROM active i WHERE i.kind='invoice' AND i.status='active' AND i.vendor='BLUE' AND i.due_date <= '2026-10-30'), amounts AS (SELECT event_key,business_date,currency,discount_until,terms_code,CASE WHEN balance <= 0 THEN 0 WHEN balance-held <= 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance-held END AS unheld FROM balances), matched AS (SELECT i.event_key,i.unheld,i.discount_until,t.discount_bps,f.fx_num,f.fx_den FROM amounts i JOIN active t ON t.kind='terms' AND t.status='active' AND t.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t.business_date <= i.business_date JOIN active f ON f.kind='fx' AND f.status='active' AND f.currency=i.currency AND f.business_date <= i.business_date WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active t2 WHERE t2.kind='terms' AND t2.status='active' AND t2.terms_code=i.terms_code AND t2.business_date <= i.business_date AND t2.business_date > t.business_date) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active f2 WHERE f2.kind='fx' AND f2.status='active' AND f2.currency=i.currency AND f2.business_date <= i.business_date AND f2.business_date > f.business_date)), fractions AS (SELECT event_key,unheld,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,unheld*CASE WHEN '2026-10-23' <= discount_until THEN 10000-discount_bps ELSE 10000 END*fx_num AS numerator,10000*fx_den AS denominator FROM matched), rounded AS (SELECT event_key,unheld,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,CAST((numerator-(numerator % denominator))/denominator AS BIGINT)+CASE WHEN 2*(numerator % denominator) >= denominator THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS usd_cents FROM fractions) SELECT event_key,unheld,discount_bps,fx_num,fx_den,usd_cents,SUM(usd_cents) OVER () AS total_usd_cents FROM rounded ORDER BY event_key"}}
